text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stocks A, D, C, and E when they showed gains, then later bought more at different prices; a realized gain is not proof that selling was best, so I should decide using forward-looking risk and return.","I added to several stocks across multiple periods, including after prices moved down, but frequent trading and averaging down can increase exposure without improving expected returns. I should size positions deliberately and avoid treating a lower price as an automatic bargain.","My account value fell to NT$98,883 by Period 10 despite earlier gains and additional purchases. I should assess total portfolio performance and risk, maintain diversification, and remember that random past price moves do not forecast what comes next."]}
